capability_specific_examples_to_freeze_i: held-out reconstruction only if the published implementation natively exposes reconstruction
missing-view reconstruction only if the method natively supports missing-view inference
cross-view retrieval only if separate-view or cross-modal embeddings are natively defined
common_core_endpoints_to_freeze_in_05cmp: representation stability under the same declared secondary resampling protocol where feasible
simulation shared-subspace recovery where a joint latent space is available
outcome_boundary: Secondary comparators remain outcome-blind. They cannot be configured or ranked using survival, metastasis, treatment, or biological-program labels.
reporting_principles: Do not create a forced single composite winner score across methods with different native capabilities.
Use common representation-level endpoints wherever mathematically comparable.
Report capability-specific endpoints only for methods that natively support them.
Do not add custom decoders, imputation modules, or supervised heads to a comparator solely to make an endpoint available.
Separate classical Bayesian and deep VAE comparator results from the frozen primary baseline/ablation table.
Clearly label all comparator analyses as secondary post-freeze benchmarking.
role: Secondary external benchmarking only. These methods do not participate in primary architecture/profile selection, 05e primary method freeze, or final-gate threshold validation.
scientific_scope_finalization: 05cmp1, frozen before any comparator scientific result, must define exact secondary simulation/TARGET datasets, metrics, preprocessing adapters, feature-budget policy, split policy, and hyperparameter-selection rule after both selected comparator implementations have been smoke-tested on 05dev0.

timing.outcomes: forbidden for comparator tuning and representation evaluation
